item.title: How to Migrate a Blog from Ghost to Hexo
item.description: 1. Introduction to Hexo Hexo is a concise, efficient, open-source static blog generator built with Node.js. Hexo can render Markdown into static HTML files extremely quickly. Like Jekyll, Ghost, and Octopress, it can be used to create a blog. Hexo has the following advantages: It uses Node.js, so setting up the environment is simple.
